notes.title: Final Update for a while!
notes.content:
I did several changes to the game to make it feel way more polished..



* pause, win and loose menus have a transition. 

* The scientist that gives you objectives has a talking animation.

notes.title: New Name and New Menu and features.
notes.content:
GOOD NEWS we are getting closer to 1.0!

with a new localization and title menu transition update as well as a new name for the game due to avoiding conflict with another app.


New Title!
New Transition to the main menu and title menu!
Fixing minor bugs.
Now offers support for 9 different languages.
Cutscenes fixed!
Achievements Fixed.

notes.title: A HUGE UPDATE! WOO HOO! Closer to 1.0
notes.content:
First off I apologizes if not all levels in single player are beatable yet! I'm working on it this week. however I did fix the "Generated" second half of Single Player. so enjoy the new updates.  debating on removing Multiplayer. But I should just make it online for four of your buddies to play!

Let's see the changes:

NEW UI FOR INGAME:

*No more figuring out how you get 3 star rankings. it's been mostly fixed up however! it's still got some bugs in some levels so I'm fixing it up!
*Arcade Mode now rewards puzzles being completed quickly with the 3 star system!

FIXES:
Auto made Levels should work now IN PUZZLE mode!  I goofed on my end on that!

Issues: 
Arcade mode still needs some tweaks sense I did goofed up the generation but it should be fixed soon once my head gets together!  The levels don't always last forever and some levels are impossible to solve in arcade mode.

I might create a level editor for public in the near future before Mobile Release!
